method: Pages rendered at 300–400 % with Edge's built-in PDF viewer (render-pdf.mjs) and read visually. The brochures are vector/outlined text (no text layer).
not_transcribed: Activity icons in the 'Actividades turísticas' tables (legend matching is error-prone; activities are taken from the brochure prose instead).
Map labels other than those cited.
inconsistencies: Capital → Ciudad Valles: 290 km / 3h 27m (Centro) vs Ciudad Valles → Capital 291 km / 3h 21m (Huasteca).
Matehuala → Salinas printed as 359 km / 3h; implausibly long for the stated time. Kept as printed, flagged.
Altiplano brochure repeats the Huasteca gastronomy box.
